in_marathi.name: Bravitha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bravitha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bravitha is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'brave'. It is a tribute to the divine feminine, symbolizing courage, strength, and resilience. In Hindu mythology, Bravitha is revered as a goddess, embodying the spirit of fearlessness and wisdom.
